result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: restaurant names are clipped in the Fastest and Popular sections.

issues.description: The last restaurant name in the Fastest near you row is cut off mid-word (“Trattoria Piccol”), so the listing is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Give each carousel card enough width or wrap/truncate the title with an ellipsis so the full name stays visible.

issues.description: The Popular restaurant title “Tokumaru Ramen” is clipped at the last letter, making the name look incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap or use a slightly smaller font / more horizontal space so the full name displays.
